spans.s:
ष्ठिव्(उ)ष्ठिवु r. 1st cl. (ष्ठीवति) r. 4th cl. (ष्ठीव्यति) To eject from the
mouth, to spit, to sputter, (the radical sibilant is unchanged in
this root;) also ष्ठीव् ।

ष्ठीव्(उ)ष्ठीवु r. 1st cl. (ष्ठीवति) r. 4th cl. (ष्ठीव्यति)
 1. To spit or eject
from the mouth.
 2. To sputter.

ष्ठीवन n. (-नं)
 1. Spitting, ejecting saliva.
 2. Saliva, spittle.
 E. ष्ठीव् and ल्युट् aff.

ष्ठीवित्वा Ind. Having spitten.
 E. ष्ठीव् to spit, क्त्वा aff.
